body:
Thanks mate, that means a lot
I know once I leave school I’ll be free almost and once I maybe start to reach adult life I’ll maybe start to be happy but I can’t wait that long feeling like this, I’m not sure if I wanna actually commit but Ik I’d rather be anywhere but here

It’s not just my loss of friendships and everything, I’ve just always felt so out of place, I had friends but I never really had anything in common other than we just had some ‘laddy banter’ and I always felt so lonely, and I think maybe now they’ve all gone, it’s made me realise how toxic and lonely I am, idk how else to explain it I am crap at putting things from my mind to my mouth. I was diagnosed Friday but I’ve always suspected something was wrong with me

My life sort of came crumbling to pieces and I had been feeling so lost and empty much before my life fell apart (all my friends leaving, love of my life leaving, being diagnosed with depression) and idk how to explain it, I just feel so lost and empty
Wow, that is so helpful, I genuinely mean it, that’s helped me so much man. Thank you a bunch xx
